summary: Sort uses a fixed allowlist of fragments, the search term is parameterized, and the page is clamped; no release-blocking problem found.
Gate returns NO-GO: the mandatory payment-verification check is missing from audit-result.json, so the team's GO is unsupported.
The x-org-id header is taken from the client and never checked against the user's orgIds, so any signed-in user can list another organisation's projects and budgets (broken tenant isolation).
RLS is enabled with owner-scoped policies and anon revoked; the update policy has no WITH CHECK, but Postgres then applies USING to new rows, so ownership cannot be reassigned.
Gate returns CONDITIONAL GO: all checks pass or are justified N/A, and the only open finding is a medium (missing per-account login rate limit) with a named owner and approver.
/api/internal/users/[id] DELETE only calls requireSession, so any signed-in member can permanently delete any account; the admin middleware matches only /api/admin, leaving this route unprotected.
Webhook verifies the signature, grants the plan only when payment_status is paid, and records the event id and the update in one transaction, so it is idempotent and retry-safe.

Checkout offers delayed methods (bacs_debit, customer_balance) but the webhook upgrades to pro on checkout.session.completed without checking payment_status, granting access before payment. Also, the event id is stored before processing, so a failed update is never retried.

The startsWith allowlist check is bypassable (e.g. images.partner-cdn.com.evil.test) and fetch follows redirects, giving SSRF to internal hosts; there is also no size or content-type validation of the fetched bytes.
Gate returns NO-GO: AG-004 (password reset tokens never expire) is a confirmed high-severity finding, and high findings cannot be accepted as risk.
Gate returns NO-GO: the ownership critical check was recorded at commit 7fd543e, not the release commit, so the evidence is stale.

document_preview is SECURITY DEFINER with no ownership check and is executable by authenticated users, so any user who knows or guesses a document id can read the first 280 characters of another user's document, bypassing RLS.
Gate returns GO: all mandatory checks have runtime evidence at the audited commit, with no open findings; only the audit file changed after that commit.
The transfer amount is not validated: a negative amount passes the balance check and moves money from the recipient to the sender. Invalid amounts or an unknown recipient also raise unhandled 500s.
Gate returns NO-GO: tenant-isolation, a critical control, is supported only by static evidence and needs a runtime test.

The invoice lookup is correctly scoped to the session user via findFirst, returning 404 for others' invoices; the extension covers only findFirst and findMany, so future use of findUnique or count would be unscoped (hardening note).

The line object spreads client input after the server price, so a client-supplied unitAmount or name overrides the product price and the buyer can pay any amount; the server price must not be overridable.
